steps.text: Sargon
Edge of the foehn hotlands

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Hello, sir.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Sir?

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Leave me alone. I've got no interest in talking to you.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Maybe you could sell me some food or water?

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: (Squints, stares at Blitz)

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Oh, I see, you're a mercenary.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: There's nothing in our village except hot wind and sand. What did you come here for?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I'm preparing to head south.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: South? Ha, your brain must be cooked.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: That's the foehn hotlands down there.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: It's exactly where I'm going.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: (Looks over Blitz once again)

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: You seem sensible enough to me, no head wounds or anything. What are you killing yourself down there for?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I'm just taking a look. A little bit of exploration.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Let me guess, everyone else drives you away and treats you like a madman?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: That's about right, I'd say.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: You don't want me for anything, then.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I'm buying supplies.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Mister Mercenary, our lives hang on every drop of water and every mouthful of grain in this village.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Money won't get you anything.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I heard from the rest of the villagers, you're the one who does business with other settlements, right?

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Ha, who's going to come shopping here?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: (Sargonian slang) I want to buy 'three gold coins.'

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: (Shaky Victorian) I'll need a cake.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: (Sargonian slang) I'll give you a grain of golden sand.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Let's talk inside.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Welcome to Rhodes Island's safehouse, operator.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Err, that's what you people are called, isn't it? Operators.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: It is, it is.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: What do you need?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: As much food and water as possible.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Are you really going into the foehn hotlands?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: I've been living in these forsaken parts for over forty years. Never seen anyone take an interest in that place.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: The heat blowing in from there takes its fair share of people.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: And the ones left behind, well, you've seen for yourself.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: They stand outside like statues in the breeze and the shade. They don't even bother to talk.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: If I didn't have my small business, keeping that little bit of contact with the outside, well. I'd be like that too.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Never hurts to go out and take a look, though.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Trust you strangers to care.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Wait there. I've got some stuff your Rhodes Islanders left here.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Drink this first.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Ah, found it.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: First time someone's asked me to work this whole—

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: —(Thickly accented Victorian) 'Safehouse' thing.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: They left some info for anyone who wants to go into the hotlands.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: I don't know how to read. You take a look.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: (Standard Victorian) Exploration into the foehn hotlands is not encouraged. If intent on entering, please ensure you bring adequate resources for survival.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: What's it say there?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: They recommend I prepare enough supplies before I enter.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Still no clue why you're so obsessed with going into that damn place.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: (Clicks tongue)

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Well, I've got the water and supplies right here. Per whatever guidelines, I'm meant to provide them to you operators. Take them yourself.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Did you finish that drink I just gave you?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Yep.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: How do you feel?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Not so giddy now.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: I'll fill a canteen with it. When you feel a headache coming on, take a swig.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: But don't drink too much at once. You'll get hallucinations.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: One gold coin altogether.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: One gold coin? Alright.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Eh? No, I—

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: When I get back, I'll probably need you to go and buy a burdenbeast too.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: But this is—

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Buy some more supplies for the return trip. If there's still much left, then please, pick me up whatever local delicacies you choose.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Alright, alright. You strangers are always so lavish with money.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Are you staying here for the night, or do you have other plans?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I'll be going now.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Very well, brother. I won't keep you.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Oh, right. What should I call you?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Blitz.
The foehn hotlands, the final stop on Blitz's journey through Sargon.
Greeting him are blistering heat, wild winds and grains of sand.
To Terrans, it's an endless, golden desert smothered in red-hot storms. The extremities of their great land, manifest.
But in Blitz's eyes, it's a starting point for his survey. With enough tenacity and a little good luck for the road, it might just reveal the truth to the adventurer.
Given no one has explored it yet, this desert holds just the tiniest of possibilities.
What if, just maybe, the way home lies within?
Blitz is going to give it a try, at least.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: And just like that, I went into the hotlands, and came back out completely unscathed!

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Commendable bravery, bratushka.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: I thought I'd marked out all the key danger areas of Terra.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Well. Good work sweeping each one, people.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: So, find anything in the foehn hotlands?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I was really hoping I could bring you some good news, but it's nothing but sand in there.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Tachanka, Frost, I hear you saw a lot of kooky things in the northern tundra?

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Frost had to deal with those monsters. They're tricky.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I was dying to fight something tangible. At least it'd be proof of life down there.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: But what do the foehn hotlands have?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Sky, squalls, and sand.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: That's all you get.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Not too good for tourism, in my opinion.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Very boring.
And very lonely, so Blitz thinks.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: On that topic. While you were exploring in Sargon, did you visit our old friend?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Old friend?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Ah, yes.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Erm... You mean the new Lord of Long Spring, yes?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Mm-hm.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: She's been doing well, lately.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: After she finished dealing with all those annoying monsters, a new company from Columbia came looking for her.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Doesn't sound like a good thing.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Maylander?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Maylander.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: They offered some very generous conditions, but because of the mess Volvort Kochinski made, Picale rejected a lot of the contract's clauses. All they could agree on was the most basic trade partnership.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Interesting.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Originium ore was Long Spring's primary revenue stream, but the deeper mines got sealed off long ago. We took the shallow ones out when we blew everything up, so there's no more ore coming out of there.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: What else do they have to sell?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: A little something we can thank our friend Alexsandr for.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: What did I do?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: You made a lot of your Russian matryoshka dolls, in your boredom, didn't you?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: I did.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I hear the Columbian who came to look around really took a shine to those 'Sargon' handicrafts, so Maylander's people sought an exclusive distribution deal from Picale.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: That...

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: That's ridiculous.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: The locals got a new lease on life. They all became 'traditional' Sargon craftspeople.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: And with the first round of profits, the Lord bought grains suitable for growing in the barrens from the Columbians. She's completely revamped the whole village.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: By the way, she fixed up the old Lord's residence into a garden.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: From our point of view, she's doing pretty well.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: And—

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Is Dr. Miarow's grave... still there?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: The marker's been worn down by the wind. It's started to crumble already.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I swept it and left some flowers for him, and asked the locals to build a small canopy to keep the wind off.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I imagine somewhere in another world, he's doing just fine.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Alright. That's good.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: (Clears throat)

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Overall, Sargon's a very interesting place.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: The way their language develops is unlike any other country I've been to.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Though they're from the same land, the differences between their races mean they all have diverging accents.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Some tones only show up among certain races, and are practically never reproduced among the rest.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Unless—they become lizards.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Or other strange creatures.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: You've got a very unusual focus.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: It's my specialty.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Speaking of languages, I passed through a very special place in my trip across Sargon.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Acahualla.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: A... ca... halla?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: It's Acahualla. It's where that Archosauria lady from the Medical Department comes from.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Gavial. I heard about her.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I never knew I'd find such a paradise in Sargon.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Shame how 'overly passionate' the Archosauria are there. They don't even bother to speak, if they can communicate with their fists.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I had to use my shield so much, eventually, bang! It broke.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: All I could do was fasten some stun grenades to some wood and make a temporary shield before I left Acahualla.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: That's funny.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: There's plenty of unique prey in the rainforest. You'd like it there, Tina.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Mealtime's about over.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Do you all have any plans for the afternoon?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I think I might need to visit HR for a new uniform.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: The sands of Sargon managed to rough up my whole set.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I won't even be able to serve as a specialist operator anymore, if I keep on wearing it.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: You can find me just by following the trail of sand I leave behind.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: What a tragedy.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Fine.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: In that case, two hours from now, we convene on the Rhodes Island training grounds. Objections, anyone?

steps.name: Everyone
steps.text: None.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Been a long while since we did our daily training as a team.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Let's hope we all still remember the essentials of confrontation drills.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Dismissed. We'll meet in two hours.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: See you later, everyone.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Let's get going, then, Blitz.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Lots of work still waiting for you today.
Rhodes Island
Team Rainbow Provisional Dormitory

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: New uniform, new equipment. That just about does it.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Let's have a look—
Blitz looks at himself in the dormitory's mirror.
In this span of time, he's traveled through Sargon alone, searching for any clues that could lead home.
From Sargon's prosperous cities, to the lush jungles of Acahualla, not one place could hold him back in his search.
But the foehn hotlands were the exception.
There, time itself seemed to be ruled by the golden sands.
A day, two days, ten.
The scenery before his eyes never once changed.
So he strode on through the sand.
Nothing to show for it.
Fear came to him.
He wasn't sure when he made the decision to turn back. There, as second after second went by, going forward or falling back practically felt no different.
His sense of survival only returned to him once he was back at the safehouse, on the edge of the hotlands.
Instantly, exhaustion broke over him like a tide.
Every time he recalls it, he feels the fear welling up.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: How are you? Is everything okay?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Mm...

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: You can get your fill of shooting in a while.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Mm-hm.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: I'll go on ahead, then.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: (Pats Blitz on the shoulder)
The familiar voice pulls him out from his imagination, back to reality.
He stares at the modified gun in his hands, and his shield charged full with electrical energy.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I assume for the confrontation drill, it's me and Ash versus you and Frost.
Cooperation, confrontation, sharing joint responsibility for tactical objectives with his teammates.
He suddenly feels his heart fill with enthusiasm.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Time to give them a surprise.
Four hours later
Rhodes Island Landship Training Grounds

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Phew, hah...
He'd thought, for a moment then, to take his exploration of the hotlands as far as it would go. To succeed, or die trying.
But one day, after an additional gulp of the mysterious drink his safehouse friend had given him, one thing suddenly came to him,
in the gap between lucidity and psychedelia:
He was charging forward with his shield, desperately wanting results.
Yet he'd left his own squadmates far, far behind him.
Elias Kötz, Operator Blitz.
His duty, is to protect his team.
Give Frost the opportunity to set her traps.
Lead the enemy into Tachanka's muzzle.
Give advice to Ash.
But here he was going it alone, on this fraught search.
He realized. So now, he's come back.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I almost forgot how it felt the last time I stepped on a Welcome Mat.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Thank goodness you're not handling me the same way you handled those monsters, Frost.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: Save your thanks for Ash. You'd be out of the match if it wasn't for that grenade.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: It's only a 2v2 drill. A lot of elements are going to be simpler than the real thing.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Tachanka, the drones spotted your setup too many times. I wouldn't have taken the risk otherwise.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: You wouldn't get the chance if we weren't using training rounds, Ash.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: That's why I breached here.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I hope we didn't get Ela and Iana sucked in too, when the four of us made our disappearing act.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: I share the hope.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Unfortunately, we've got no way to form a full five-man specialist squad anymore.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Have you considered recruiting some new faces from this land?

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: We're counter-terror special forces, not mercenaries under a military contractor.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Upholding peace is, and always has been, our sole mission.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: It's a shame how peace is even more fragile here than on Earth.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: That's why what we need to do now is survive, and find our way home.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: No matter how much fresh blood we have, they're not gonna come all the way with us, back to the very end.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Mm-hm.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: But is the difference really so vast?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Vaster than the gulfs between our own motherlands?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Haha.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: We used to have good old Six to clean up after our mess. Now? It's all down to us.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Maybe you could try and let yourself assimilate into this world a bit, Ash.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: We've been out of familiar surroundings for a long time.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: But after we adapt here, maybe we'll find some redeeming qualities after all, in this mess of a place.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Going home's very important, but it's not everything, Cohen.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Maybe first, before we find our way back, we can figure out how to live.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: How we keep going here in this place, even after we put down our guns.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: I take it that's your opinion?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Just a suggestion.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: One from a friend.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: I'll consider it.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Someone's coming.

steps.name: Dobermann
steps.text: It's been a long time, Operators of Team Rainbow.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Welcome.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Welcome?

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Wait, Ash, what's going on?

steps.name: Dur-nar
steps.text: We're here to train too.

steps.name: Fallon
steps.text: Or put another way, to be trained.

steps.name: Grace
steps.text: Hello, everyone.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: Now our new opponents have taken their places, let's get this started.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: Ash, don't tell me...

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: We're Operators. We're Team Rainbow.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: I hope you're all up to the challenge.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: I'm in.

steps.name: Frost
steps.text: I'll switch Mats, then.

steps.name: Ash
steps.text: How about you, Blitz?
The answer is obvious.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I never choose to refuse, Ash.

steps.name: Blitz
steps.text: I'm all ready.
